items.text:
I do really enjoy the game and can play it for hours. However, the fact that I have to make sure I save every 5-10 minutes just so I don't lose a ton of progress due to bugs or just random jank is a big issue. If they had focused on bug fixes and improving the issues that are in the content already I feel like I could recommend it more to others.

I stopped playing after logging over 100 hours due to the fire update in EA, it made the game unplayable really with the amount of issues it came with. They seem to be pushing adding more content but the base of the game is just lacking so adding the extras is just like putting glitter on dirt.

Its fine to play right now but I've already had save files corrupted and deaths due to bugs/random AI. This is during the 30 hours I have put in after release. My character will still walk out into space with no helmet on which was supposed to be fixed a while ago and storage has to all be done manually. Your items don't get registered properly whether that is during task or otherwise: Batteries will be taken out of the chargers for no reason, they will stop doing everything after swapping batteries when needed and wont restart the tasks, refuses to stack items in bags and just goes one by one, character is highly unreliable I cant even get other crew due to the issues I have with one.

Its not player friendly. It can be played but I don't think majority of gamers would enjoy this game especially not as is. It can be fun but once you get killed from your ship randomly going hyper speed for no reason it becomes annoying. If they fixed the UI and focused more on the original content I think it would be worth playing. I cant recommend it in its current state. They do do regular fixes but they also add more problems by adding more content. I haven't tried the bounty system or races because I'm not confident they even work.

Buy it if you can stand jank and slog. Otherwise stay away for a few more years until its either fully threshed out or development quits.
items.text_zh:
我真的很喜欢这款游戏，可以玩上好几个小时。然而，我必须确保每5到10分钟就保存一次，以免因为bug或随机的故障而丢失大量进度，这是个很大的问题。如果他们专注于修复bug并改进现有内容中的问题，我觉得我会更愿意推荐给别人。

在早期访问的火焰更新后，我玩了超过100小时就停止玩了，它带来的大量问题真的让游戏变得没法玩。他们似乎在推动添加更多内容，但游戏的基础本身就很欠缺，所以添加额外内容就像是在泥土上撒亮片。

现在玩起来还行，但我已经遇到过存档损坏以及因bug/随机AI导致的死亡。这是在我发布后投入的30小时里发生的。我的角色仍然会不戴头盔走进太空，这本来早就该修复了，而且存储必须全部手动完成。你的物品无法正确注册，无论是在任务中还是其他情况下：电池会无缘无故从充电器中被取出，在需要时更换电池后它们会停止做所有事情，不会重新开始任务，拒绝将物品堆叠在包里，只是一件一件地放，角色非常不可靠，我甚至无法获得其他船员，因为我在一个角色上就遇到了这些问题。

它对玩家不友好。可以玩，但我认为大多数玩家不会喜欢这款游戏，尤其是现在这个样子。它可能很有趣，但一旦你的飞船无缘无故突然超高速飞行导致你死亡，就变得很烦人。如果他们修复了UI并更专注于原有内容，我认为它值得一玩。在目前的状态下我无法推荐它。他们确实定期修复，但同时也通过添加更多内容带来了更多问题。我还没试过赏金系统或竞速，因为我不确定它们是否能正常工作。

如果你能忍受故障和苦差事就买吧。否则再等几年，直到它要么完全打磨好，要么开发停止。

items.text:
Unfortunately, I cannot in good conscience recommend this game. I like the concept of it - starting with a small ship in mortgage, access to a ship boneyard for a nominal fee (or for free if you're good at hiding from cops) and some skills in building ships and tearing them apart. Simulated electrical systems, pressure, malfunctions such as fires or navigation station software bugging out. Build out your ship, travel the Solar System, do some stuff - questing, trading, asteriod mining, even participating in a war, good stuff, good ideas.

The problem is bad implementation. The deeper you go into the game, the more problems you find with various systems. The gases don't go through adiabatic cooling, which is reasonable for a game, so any gases you pump into your ship are at room temperature, but *sometimes* re-pressurising a room ends up with it being barely a few Kelvin hot. Characters that are prone to choosing the way around the ship if they can, doesn't matter if that way happens to go outside and they have no EVA suit on (space, remember?). Autotasking, which is basically required if you don't want to click your character through installing 400 floors and 80 walls one by one, is very bad in a lot of ways that are too long to go into details here. Barely anything happens during time skip, so if you want any work done, you'll have to let your characters do the work and go watch Youtube or something. Characters still can't replace batteries in tools without dropping flat batteries on the ground instead of properly inserting them into chargers. And speaking of tools, they will choose the first tool they find when you need one, not "the best in their inventory" or anything like that, so you need to take care to not leave old tools in any reachable places. CO2 filters never get used up, so while CO2 buildup is still bad for your character, that particular system is half-baked. Item sorting in kiosks for buying/selling is arcane.

Flight is Newtonian... to a point, it doesn't simulate gravity faithfully enough (in my opinion) and the navigation station doesn't give you enough tools to utilize the fact. Fuel isn't accounted in ship mass, which you could argue is a gameplay decision, but cargo in cargo pods does count in ship mass, so I dunno. Autopilot for interplanetary travel cheats, uses too much fuel and still smacks you into planets sometimes.

I could go on and on, but you get the idea. I have two problems with this game. I played this game for 250 hours total, about 150 hours back when I just bought it and about 100 hours near and after release. This game pulled me in enough that I tried to figure out and work around all this problems, be it by modding, adapting my processes to the s*** factor, or any other ways. But at some point my will just broke. This game is an exercise in frustration, and in the end frustration subsumes any amount of enjoyment I got out of this game. The game is full of bugs, Discord bug forum is full of bugs, and only a small amount of them gets acknowledged and even smaller about fixed. The devs say "report the bugs", but even after you report it *and provide source code for a mod that fixes it*, chances are the bug will stay in the game for weeks ahead. I don't have patience to wait for months, but some well-known problems have stayed for years, apparently, so make what you will of it. That's the first and the biggest problem. The second, as the dev's community manager eloquently put it in Discord, "this game's elevator pitch is Firefly episode generator". There is a reason I'm indifferent to Firefly as opposed to Star Trek, and it's the setting. This game won't tell you power draw or any other specs for spaceship equipment. It won't tell you how much thrust thrusters produce or how far sensors can detect things. You're supposed to wing it. I don't like it.

By the way, I like Rimworld. Rimworld is also a "story generator". It's also a lot, lot, lot better implementation-wise than this game. Don't get fooled by comparison.

So there it is. Apparently this game has a deep simulation for characters relations, mental needs etcetc, but it was too arcane for me to figure it out, so I just ignored it. As is the norm for the game, it won't tell you anything, you're supposed to figure things out. Maybe this is not a one-guy-or-small-team-flying-spaceship simulation game but a dating simulator in space with elements of shipbuilding? I dunno. If you want to get the game, make absolutely sure your expectations match what it is.
items.text_zh:
遗憾的是，我无法凭良心推荐这款游戏。我喜欢它的概念——从一艘还在按揭的小船开始，可以花点小钱（或者如果你擅长躲警察就免费）进入飞船坟场，还有一些建造和拆解飞船的技能。模拟电气系统、压力、火灾或导航站软件故障等故障。建造你的飞船，在太阳系中旅行，做些事情——任务、贸易、小行星采矿，甚至参与战争，好东西，好想法。

问题在于糟糕的实现。你在游戏中越深入，就会发现各种系统的问题越多。气体不会经历绝热冷却，这对游戏来说还算合理，所以你泵入飞船的任何气体都是室温的，但*有时候*给房间重新加压后，它却只有几开尔文的温度。角色倾向于选择绕飞船的路，如果可能的话，不管那条路是否会通到外面，而他们又没穿EVA服（太空，记得吗？）。自动任务分配，如果你不想一个个点击角色安装400块地板和80面墙，基本上就是必需的，但它在很多方面都非常糟糕，细节太长这里就不展开了。时间跳过期间几乎什么都不会发生，所以如果你想完成任何工作，你就得让角色干活，自己去看YouTube什么的。角色仍然无法更换工具里的电池，而是把没电的电池扔在地上，而不是正确地插入充电器。说到工具，当你需要一个工具时，他们会选择找到的第一个工具，而不是“他们库存中最好的”之类的，所以你得小心，不要把旧工具留在任何可触及的地方。CO2过滤器永远不会用完，所以虽然CO2积累对你的角色仍然有害，但那个特定系统是半生不熟的。售货亭里买卖物品的分类方式神秘莫测。

飞行是牛顿式的……到一定程度，它（在我看来）没有足够忠实地模拟重力，导航站也没有给你足够的工具来利用这一事实。燃料不计入飞船质量，你可以说这是游戏性决定，但货舱里的货物确实计入飞船质量，所以我不知道。行星际旅行的自动驾驶作弊，使用过多燃料，有时还会把你撞进行星。

我可以继续说下去，但你明白意思了。我对这款游戏有两个问题。我总共玩了250小时，大约150小时是我刚买的时候，大约100小时是在发布前后。这款游戏足够吸引我，以至于我试图弄清楚并绕过所有这些问题，无论是通过模组、调整我的流程来适应这坨屎，还是其他方式。但到了某个时候，我的意志就崩溃了。这款游戏是一场挫折的练习，最终挫折感吞没了我从中获得的任何乐趣。游戏充满bug，Discord的bug论坛充满bug，只有一小部分被承认，被修复的就更少了。开发者说“报告bug”，但即使你报告了*并且提供了修复它的模组源代码*，这个bug很可能还会在游戏中停留数周。我没有耐心等几个月，但一些众所周知的问题显然已经存在多年了，所以你自己看着办吧。这是第一个也是最大的问题。第二个，正如开发者的社区经理在Discord上雄辩地说的，“这款
游戏的电梯游说是“萤火虫剧集生成器”。我对《萤火虫》不像对《星际迷航》那样感兴趣是有原因的，那就是它的设定。这款游戏不会告诉你飞船设备的功耗或任何其他规格。它不会告诉你推进器产生多少推力，或者传感器能探测到多远的东西。你应该自己随机应变。我不喜欢这样。

顺便说一句，我喜欢《环世界》。《环世界》也是一个“故事生成器”。在实现方面，它也比这款游戏好得多得多得多。别被这种比较骗了。

所以就是这样。显然，这款游戏对角色关系、心理需求等有深度模拟，但对我来说太晦涩难懂了，所以我干脆忽略了它。就像这款游戏的常态一样，它什么都不会告诉你，你应该自己去弄明白。也许这不是一个单人或小团队驾驶飞船的模拟游戏，而是一个带有造船元素的太空约会模拟器？我不知道。如果你想买这款游戏，一定要绝对确保你的期望与它的实际内容相符。

items.text:
Normally I don't do reviews mainly because I play a lot of games that have thousands of reviews saying its amazing. But this game... takes amazing to the next level.

I am highly impressed by everything it includes. From the ship customization, 02 bottles, eva suits and the economy plus the orbits of planets and stations... its an amazing game. 

HOWEVER, it is hard to learn at first - BUT EXTREMELY rewarding and fun especially if you like scavenging, building and progressing as a player. 

I would love to see more automation for example when you have 500 plus items looted from a ship I wish there was a button which can fast forward to the end of all your repairs... I also have found sleep extremely annoying as sometimes I have to sleep 18 hours to get rested but other times just a few hours. Which is ultimately really boring. So I would love to see a feature that allows you to sleep until rested or something of that nature - even if it is a mod. 

I would also say that the graphics are lacking... It is really difficult to see things as there can be a lot of clutter. So I would suggest either A) redoing ALL of the items/equipment B) creating different views for people. For example a view that does not show all the conduits that would help, or perhaps a search bar showing you where something is in your ship as at times its hard to find. 

As I haven't really done a whole lot in the game besides salvage and build my ship I am wondering if there are other aspects to the game such as bounty hunting etc as there are no real tutorials. I wish all the aspects of the game were more obvious.

Overall amazing game so far.
items.text_zh:
通常我不写评测，主要是因为我玩的很多游戏都有成千上万条评测说它很棒。但这款游戏……把很棒提升到了另一个层次。

它包含的一切都让我印象深刻。从飞船自定义、氧气瓶、EVA宇航服，到经济系统，再加上行星和空间站的轨道……这是一款很棒的游戏。

然而，一开始很难学——但回报极高，也很有趣，尤其是如果你喜欢打捞、建造和作为玩家不断进步。

我很想看到更多自动化，例如当你从一艘飞船上搜刮了500多件物品时，我希望有一个按钮可以快进到你所有修理工作的结尾……我还觉得睡觉极其烦人，因为有时我得睡18个小时才能休息好，但其他时候只要几个小时。这最终真的很无聊。所以我很想看到一个能让你睡到休息好为止之类的功能——即使是mod也好。

我还要说画面有所欠缺……真的很难看清东西，因为可能会有很多杂乱。所以我建议要么A）重做所有物品/装备，要么B）为人们创建不同的视图。例如，一个不显示所有管线的视图会有帮助，或者也许一个搜索栏，显示你飞船里某样东西在哪里，因为有时候很难找到。

由于我在游戏里除了打捞和建造我的飞船之外并没有真正做太多事情，我想知道游戏是否还有其他方面，比如赏金狩猎等等，因为并没有真正的教程。我希望游戏的所有方面都更明显。

总的来说，到目前为止是很棒的游戏。

items.text:
There is a lot to like about this game, but it just fails at several critical points to be something I recommend to others. 

The glaring issue is the NPCs. The dialog and mood system is just terrible. 20+ dialog options you have to scroll through is just so tedious and unnecessary. Your crew won't work? Well, if you look for answers online you get debug commands as a standard answer... Just capping a work time, a free time, and a sleep time and forcing the NPCs to work, sleep, and entertain themselves during those schedules would be a better system than their moods dictating their actions. You get 20 billion little tasks from delivering scrap to helping with corp issues, the consequences of these tasks you'll never see. 

The NPCs should be there to enrich the setting with lore, consequence to actions, and relationship building. Your crew should be there to make your life easier with repairs, salvage, and building. 

Other minor issues in the UI, especially when you have multiple inventory screens open. It would be nice to know which backpack has what slots when you have 3 on, because inventory management through recursivly stuffing things in things seems to be the incentivised gameplay. Do I really want to store all my high G pens in a back pack, which then gets stuffed into a shelf which I can't tell apart from my scrap packs? Well its that or have multiple shelves for 1 item type, or having them spread over the floor in a mess. 

It would also be nice to have some settings to the UI like docking the windows somewhere, making them smaller or larger, etc. 

The salvage portion of the game feels pretty good. If you sit and read the manuals you can figure things out pretty easily to expand your ship. RCS also feels pretty good. Not realistic on the approach to docking, but nothing is going to beat hellion in that regard. 

Pirates are hit and miss. At first the game felt good, I got a pirate tracking me every 4 or so hours of game play. And then 3 in a row, and the tracking warning never stopping even after killing all of them and returning to port. Combat feels like its tacked on to the dialog system or vice versa, which is just terrible. 

It feels like this setting and the player in it has so much potential: you could start out as a low end scrapper and eventually come out owning and opperating your own refurb buisness, or become a dare devil system explorer, or become a bounty hunter or detective or a billion other things. But the game has a very far way to go to get to any of that, and some of the current systems in place either need to be scrapped entirely or modified heavily to make it something I'd recommend to others.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏有很多值得喜欢的地方，但它在几个关键点上就是失败了，让我无法推荐给别人。

最明显的问题是NPC。对话和情绪系统简直糟透了。20多个对话选项你得滚动浏览，太繁琐也太没必要了。你的船员不干活？好吧，如果你上网找答案，得到的标准回答就是调试命令……干脆设定一个工作时间、一个自由时间和一个睡眠时间，强制NPC在这些时间段内工作、睡觉和娱乐，这比让他们的情绪决定行动要好得多。你会收到200亿个小任务，从运送废料到帮忙处理公司问题，这些任务的后果你永远也看不到。

NPC应该用来丰富设定，通过背景故事、行动的后果和关系建设来充实世界。你的船员应该通过维修、打捞和建造来让你的生活更轻松。

UI方面还有其他小问题，尤其是当你打开多个物品栏界面时。当你身上带着3个背包时，能知道哪个背包有哪些槽位就好了，因为通过递归地把东西塞进东西里来进行物品管理似乎是被鼓励的玩法。我真的想把所有高G笔都放在一个背包里，然后这个背包又被塞进一个我分不清是货架还是废料包的架子里吗？好吧，要么这样，要么为一种物品类型准备多个货架，要么把它们乱七八糟地摊在地上。

如果有一些UI设置就好了，比如把窗口停靠在某个地方，让它们变小或变大等等。

游戏的打捞部分感觉相当不错。如果你坐下来读手册，你很容易就能搞清楚如何扩展你的飞船。RCS感觉也相当不错。对接方式不真实，但在这方面没有什么能比得上Hellion。

海盗时好时坏。一开始游戏感觉不错，每玩4小时左右就有一个海盗追踪我。然后连续来了3个，而且追踪警告一直不停，即使杀光他们回到港口后也不停。战斗感觉像是硬塞进对话系统的，或者反过来，简直糟透了。

感觉这个设定和其中的玩家有这么大的潜力：你可以从低端废料回收者做起，最终拥有并经营自己的翻新业务，或者成为冒险的系统探索者，或者成为赏金猎人或侦探，或者做其他亿万种事情。但游戏要达到这些还有很长的路要走，而且目前的一些系统要么需要彻底废弃，要么需要大幅修改，才能让它成为我会推荐给别人的东西。

items.text:
At this moment I recommend the game mainly for people that want to support the Devs by the purchase / want to help debugging / will have patience with the possible game breaking bugs.

I definitely recommend to backup the saves in some way to not lose the whole progress once you get suddenly killed without any prior warning.

Having said that, I really had a blast so far, despite the bugs.

Once, I got stuck in the pod on the side of nav. console after exiting it.
I had the internal layout already changed from the default and there was a heater placed in the way.
It was unfortunately not possible to uninstall the heater from that side. So the long way was:
Uninstall the RCS thruster, pressure suit on, hold the breath, uninstall 3-4 hull panels on the side, walk on the side of the ship, quickly turn off the oxy pump to not vent remainings of the tank in space. Install back the hull panels, still holding the breath :D, turn on the oxy pump and finally pressure suit off.
I was not really looking at the time, tbh I did not expect it will be doable in one breath. The air was thin with no N2, and 14kg O2 left in the tank but I survived :)

There is very nice foundation laid out and like the Neo scavenger, the user interface is very unusual and minimalistic in a way, but that really makes those games to stand out.

I wonder what Ostranauts will become in the end, I can Imagine, even space combat in the FTL style would be possible with how the game controls works :)
items.text_zh:
此时此刻，我推荐这款游戏，主要是针对那些想通过购买来支持开发者／想帮忙调试／对可能出现的破坏游戏的bug有耐心的人。

我绝对建议以某种方式备份存档，以免在你突然毫无预警地被杀死时失去全部进度。

话虽如此，尽管有这些bug，到目前为止我真的玩得很开心。

有一次，我从导航控制台旁边的pod里出来后卡在了里面。
我已经把内部布局从默认状态改过了，而且有个加热器放在了挡路的位置。
不幸的是，无法从那一侧卸载加热器。所以漫长的办法是：
卸载RCS推进器，穿上压力服，屏住呼吸，卸载侧面的3-4块船体面板，走到飞船侧面，迅速关掉氧气泵，以免把罐里剩下的氧气排到太空里。装回船体面板，仍然屏住呼吸 :D，打开氧气泵，最后脱掉压力服。
说实话，我当时没怎么看时间，我真没想到一口气能做完。空气很稀薄，没有N2，罐里还剩14kg O2，但我活下来了 :)

这里打下了非常好的基础，而且和Neo Scavenger一样，用户界面非常不寻常，在某种意义上是极简主义的，但这确实让这些游戏脱颖而出。

我很好奇Ostranauts最终会变成什么样，我可以想象，甚至以这款游戏操控方式的运作原理，FTL风格的太空战斗也是有可能的 :)
